name: nativephp/mobile-ota
description: Over-the-air PHP payload updates for NativePHP Mobile

bridge_functions.name: Ota.Check
bridge_functions.description: Ask Bifrost GET /api/apps/{uuid}/ota whether an update is available

bridge_functions.name: Ota.Download
bridge_functions.description: Download an OTA zip to core updates/pending.zip for next-boot apply

bridge_functions.name: Ota.Apply
bridge_functions.description: Queue the pending zip for core to extract on the next boot

bridge_functions.name: Ota.Rollback
bridge_functions.description: Re-drop the last pending zip as updates/pending.zip for next-boot apply

bridge_functions.name: Ota.GetStatus
bridge_functions.description: Last downloaded version and whether a pending zip is queued for next boot

bridge_functions.name: Ota.Prompt
bridge_functions.description: Native yes/no dialog when an update is available
